title: Report: PureGym Shares Thumb Workouts to Prepare for GTA VI Launch
description: GameSpot reports PureGym shared three thumb exercises from trainer David Hope to help players warm up before Grand Theft Auto VI releases on November 19, alongside related launch-day projections and themed food at Miami's Kaseya Center.
youtubeTitle: GTA VI Launch Prep: PureGym Reveals Thumb Workouts Before November 19
socialHook: PureGym has shared three thumb workouts to help players warm up before Grand Theft Auto VI launches on November 19, according to GameSpot.

sections.heading: PureGym Thumb Workouts for GTA VI
paragraphs: GameSpot reports that fitness company PureGym shared three thumb workouts from personal trainer David Hope to help players prepare for Grand Theft Auto VI. The routine includes tapping the thumb with each finger on the same hand, forming a fist with the thumb on the outside, and performing finger pushups by pressing both hands fingertips into the floor. PureGym recommends repeating each exercise 10 times before and after extended gaming sessions.

sections.heading: GTA VI Release Date and Related Reports
paragraphs: According to GameSpot, Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to release on November 19. The outlet also cited an economics professor projecting that 1.5 million people in America could call in sick around the launch, and noted that Miami's Kaseya Center, home of the NBA's Heat, currently features GTA-themed Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell food locations.

sections.heading: What Remains Unknown
paragraphs: GameSpot's report does not state whether Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive endorsed the PureGym routine, and it provides no methodology for the economics professor's projection. Details on how long the Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell offerings will remain at Kaseya Center were also not included.
